properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 10:37AM CDT until September 14 at 4:30PM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Andrew County in northwestern Missouri...
Southeastern Holt County in northwestern Missouri...

* WHEN...Until 430 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of creeks, streams, and other low-lying and
flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1034 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms occurred early this morning.
Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the warned
area. Between 3 and 7 inches of rain have fallen across the
warned area.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Savannah, Oregon, Forest City, Fillmore, Rosendale and Rea.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT UNTIL 430 PM CDT THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 8:29AM CDT until September 14 at 1:30PM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 829 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain have tracked north and east of the warned area. Between 2 and 4
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to
begin shortly due to runoff from earlier rainfall.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
King City, Pattonsburg, Mcfall and Ford City.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 5:18AM EDT until September 14 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Norton has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Rhode Island...

Wood River At Hope Valley affecting Washington County.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 200 PM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Wood River at Hope Valley.

* WHEN...From early this morning to this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 5.0 feet, In Richmond, floodwaters begin to pond onto
Wood River Drive. In Hopkinton off of Main Street, the Wood River
begins to flood Dow Park.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 4:15 AM EDT Monday the stage was 5.1 feet. The river will be
near or just above flood stage this morning before dropping below
flood stage this afternoon.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 4:15 AM EDT Monday was 5.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 2.1 feet Wednesday
evening.
- Flood stage is 5.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 5.1
feet on 01/27/1952.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT FROM EARLY THIS MORNING TO THIS AFTERNOON
